approved_scope: one 512x512 text-only frame, 12 steps, no refs/masks/LoRA/variants/upscale

derivation.note: Windows COW mmap still reserves full view commit. Sequential preserves original CPU state_dict; it avoids whole-model GPU to CPU replacement copies, not the original commit charge.
derivation.import_allowance_basis: One actual worker import-only attempt: about 2 GiB private commit; model load/denoising never started. Future 11.5 GiB admission equals unchanged 9.5 GiB post-import budget plus 2 GiB import allowance.

installed_source_evidence.fact: Sequential saves CPU state dictionaries and attaches per-submodule Accelerate hooks; accelerator required; no Linux-only branch.
Original CPU state_dict retained for cpu_offload.
Fetch original weight map per forward; replace parameters with meta after forward, instead of copying GPU weights back to CPU.
Component offload performs module.to(cpu) and module.to(execution_device).
safetensors load_file mmap unless disabled; dtype conversion requestedfloat16, so F16 tensors retain matching dtype.
Windows uses pread, explicitly because mmap reserves COW commit for the entire file.
VAE force_upcast promotes dtype for decode, then restores fp16; transient budget includes this.

primary_sources.fact: Windows private mapping uses PAGE_WRITECOPY and FILE_MAP_COPY.
COW commit charge covers the entire view even before writes.
Sequential offload works per submodule and is much slower. Do not move pipeline to CUDA first.

synthetic_native_proof.commit_metric: GetPerformanceInfo CommitTotal*PageSize; background allocation noise possible

limitations: Estimated guard is not an inference bound or OOM guarantee.
Only the harness verifies pinned model file SHA256.
Production LoRA, masks, variants and other painters are preserved but real inference remains untested.
One real import-only worker attempt stopped safely; no model load or image inference was performed. The shared durable claim remains and blocks any retry.

before_import.weights_storage: Diffusers private COW mmap; Transformers Windows pread CPU tensors
before_import.guard_reason: Windows sequential CPU offload; 6.46 GiB fp16 weights still consume commit (Diffusers COW mmap and Transformers Windows pread). Estimated 1.5 GiB imports, 1 GiB transient allocations/VAE fp32, 2 GiB reserve; not a measured inference bound

after_import.weights_storage: Diffusers private COW mmap; Transformers Windows pread CPU tensors

attempt_history.reason: The original 11 GiB gate admitted the child, but import private memory reached about 2 GiB and machine commit headroom fell to 9.22 GiB, below the unchanged 9.5 GiB after-import guard. Worker exited before painter()/model load.
